description: This PHP source file defines an interface named CrudEndpoint within the namespace OrangeHRM\Core\Api\V2. The interface extends two other interfaces: CollectionEndpoint and ResourceEndpoint, indicating that it is intended to specify a contract for CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) API endpoints in the OrangeHRM system. The file includes licensing and project description comments and appears to be part of a larger API framework for the HRM system.
